quests.title: Brand-New Invitation Board!

dialogue.t: Alright, now that Prince has made a few adjustments to the Invitation Board, everyone with an invite can now enter this special room here and duel with you.
Your friends won't have to travel long distances to get here. Moreover, the room makes it convenient for anyone to stay for a duel, regardless of who they are.
Huh? What do you mean, "there's no way a cat can accomplish such an impossible feat"? Hmph, you still have a lot to learn about Prince.
By which I mean, you still don't know a thing about what cats are capable of! Anyway, feel free to use the new Invitation Board and invite your friends for a duel in the special room!

quests.description: Shuyun seems to have something to tell you…
